item.name: Arcanist's Armor

effects.title: Mega Shield
effects.text: Force Field Aura Grants 25% Damage Reflection for 5 seconds.

effects.title: Shield
effects.text: Grants +4 armor and +8% Magic Resistance to all other allies within 1200 radius.

notes: Damage done by this item is considered reflected damage. Reflected damage does not provide any lifesteal and cannot be reflected.
item.lore: An exquisite piece commissioned by a paranoid monarch who choked on a piece of fruit long before the item saw its intended use.
